FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THE
UNDER SECTION 65A(2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS the office of a member in Dodangoda Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of not attending meetingsof the Council for a period of three months without permission ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United People's Freedom Alliance to whichthe former member, Nanthulage Cyril Fernando belonged was required by me under Section 65A(2) of the aforesaid Ordinance,to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days, a person eligible under the ordinance for election as a member of thatDodangoda Pradeshiya Sabha who shall be declared elected as a member ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. Wilpathage DonKarunadhara being an eligible person under the aforesaid ordinance to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Hannedige Rasika Priyanga Peiris, Returning Officer of Dodangoda Pradeshiya Sabha actingin terms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies in Local Authorities(Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Wilpathage Don Karunadhara elected as amember of the Dodangoda Pradeshiya Sabha.
RASIKA PEIRIS,Returning Officer,Dodangoda Pradeshiya Sabha.District Elections Office,Kalutara,10th April, 2015.
